entity_types.name: TalkingAnimal
entity_types.description: The non-human biological entity discovered with the ability to communicate using human language.

attributes.name: species
attributes.description: The biological species of the animal.

attributes.name: vocal_ability
attributes.description: Description of the animal's linguistic capabilities and vocabulary.

attributes.name: origin_story
attributes.description: The background or location where the animal was discovered.

entity_types.name: Scientist
entity_types.description: Individual researchers or experts in biology, linguistics, or neurology studying the animal.

attributes.name: specialization
attributes.description: The specific field of expertise (e.g., Xenolinguistics, Evolutionary Biology).

attributes.name: academic_degree
attributes.description: The highest degree held by the scientist.

entity_types.name: Journalist
entity_types.description: Media professionals who report on the discovery and subsequent events to the public.

attributes.name: press_role
attributes.description: The specific role (e.g., Science Reporter, Investigative Journalist).

attributes.name: media_brand
attributes.description: The specific news outlet they represent.

entity_types.name: Activist
entity_types.description: Individuals advocating for the rights, protection, or liberation of the talking animal.

attributes.name: campaign_focus
attributes.description: The primary goal (e.g., Animal Personhood, Habitat Protection).

attributes.name: influence_score
attributes.description: A measure of their social media following or impact.

entity_types.name: GovernmentOfficial
entity_types.description: Individuals in government roles responsible for policy, legal status, or national security.

attributes.name: department_title
attributes.description: The government body they serve (e.g., Department of Interior, UN Representative).

attributes.name: legal_authority
attributes.description: The scope of their power regarding the animal's status.

entity_types.name: ReligiousLeader
entity_types.description: Individuals providing spiritual or moral interpretations of the talking animal's existence.

attributes.name: faith_group
attributes.description: The religious or philosophical tradition they represent.

attributes.name: spiritual_title
attributes.description: Their rank or title (e.g., Bishop, Imam, Rabbi).

entity_types.name: MediaOutlet
entity_types.description: Institutional organizations that broadcast news and shape public narrative.

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: The medium (e.g., TV Network, Digital News, Social Media Platform).

attributes.name: subscriber_count
attributes.description: The reach or audience size of the outlet.

entity_types.name: ResearchInstitute
entity_types.description: Organizations or laboratories dedicated to the scientific investigation of the animal.

attributes.name: scientific_domain
attributes.description: The primary area of research (e.g., Cognitive Science, Genetics).

attributes.name: budget_level
attributes.description: The financial scale of the institution's operations.

entity_types.name: Person
entity_types.description: Any individual human being not covered by specific professional or social roles.

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: The full legal name of the individual.

attributes.name: personal_bio
attributes.description: A short biography or social media profile description.

entity_types.name: Organization
entity_types.description: Any corporate, non-profit, or community group not covered by specific categories.

attributes.name: legal_org_name
attributes.description: The registered name of the organization.

attributes.name: industry_type
attributes.description: The sector in which the organization operates.

edge_types.name: REPORTS_ON
edge_types.description: The act of a journalist or media outlet providing news coverage about the animal.

edge_types.name: STUDIES
edge_types.description: Scientific investigation or observation of the animal's behavior and biology.

edge_types.name: ADVOCATES_FOR
edge_types.description: Public support or legal campaigning for the animal's rights and welfare.

edge_types.name: REGULATES
edge_types.description: The exercise of legal or administrative control over the animal's status or safety.

edge_types.name: INTERVIEWS
edge_types.description: Direct communication or questioning between a human actor and the animal.

edge_types.name: DEBATES_WITH
edge_types.description: Public disagreement or discussion between two parties regarding the animal.

simulation_requirement: Predict what happens to the world if a talking animal is discovered.
